variants.title: Neutron-activated silver foil (silver-108)
variants.sample: Silver foil activated by thermal neutrons: Ag-109(n,gamma) and Ag-107(n,gamma)Ag-108
variants.method: decay counting of the 2.4 minute component
variants.note: Silver gives two activities; the slower one, 2.38 minutes, is counted once the faster 24.6 s one has died away.

source.title: NNDC / ENSDF: Ag-108 half-life 2.382 min (Ag-110 24.56 s)

variants.title: Neutron-activated aluminium foil (aluminium-28)
variants.sample: Aluminium foil activated by thermal neutrons: Al-27(n,gamma)Al-28
variants.note: Only one stable isotope of aluminium, so the foil gives one clean activity of 2.245 minutes and a 1.78 MeV gamma ray.

source.title: NNDC / ENSDF: Al-28 half-life 2.245 min, gamma 1778.99 keV
